Chapter 6936: Collection

Chapter 6936: Collection

“This planet is a bit interesting.” An immortal said while looking at the object sealed in time.

The inhabitants were all mortals made from flesh and blood. Regions had their own distinct customs and cultures.

They only trained in martial arts at best, relying only on brute force. However, they started a civilization versed in technology. Machines on the ground and in the sky traveled at a fast speed.

Of course, they were as slow as snails compared to immortals. Nonetheless, this was an impressive feat for mortals. Other worlds without cultivation couldn’t reach this level.

The spectators also noted strange and peculiar communication devices. They could be used for many things.

“My ancestor discovered it by chance, so he sealed it in time and brought it back.” A disciple explained to the nearby guests: “All lives on the planet remain intact. The ancestor brought back the temporal-spatial sphere around them, so time can still flow normally for them.”

Having said that, he took out a vial and dripped a bit of time onto the planet. Time began to flow again.

“Whoosh!” A machine surged through the air with incredible speed. The ones on the ground rumbled and started moving forward.

The living beings had no idea that their planet had been taken by an immortal and that they had been sealed a while ago. When the drop of time ran out, everything became frozen again.

“It’s amusing.” One spectator nodded approvingly.

However, amusement was the end of it. Immortals could create dimensions so this planet was just interesting, nothing more. Only Treasure Immortal Lord would collect something like this.

“Yangmetal Eye.” Another immortal noticed an eye bigger than most planets.

It had a transparent gold color with numerous firmaments inside.

“Doesn’t this belong to Yangmetal Immortal?” His expression changed.

“Yes, my ancestor collected it.” A disciple confirmed.

Those nearby became startled because Yangmetal Immortal was relatively famous - a one-eyed giant. His eye was special for its ability to rebuild on a large scale.

His cultivation was based on this eye. Thus, his fate was rather obvious.

A few who knew him shuddered. This Treasure Immortal Lord was indeed ruthless.

“There’s something about this wood.” An immortal said while staring at another item.

A disciple nearby explained: “This is the main root of a Yin Celestial Wood, once the source of a cloudy firmament. My ancestor used all the lives in that world to grow it to this stage, it has a very pure yin-blood liquid.”

“I see, I see. No wonder it felt strange, pure yet malicious.” An immortal said.

Although this root was rare, it had few uses for immortals. It couldn’t be used for alchemy or to craft an artifact. Nevertheless, Treasure Immortal Lord still massacred a world to nourish it.

The immortals here didn’t mind since there were countless firmaments and minor worlds in Heavenrealm. Of course, they weren’t bored enough to destroy them for no reason either.

Only deviants such as Breaker Immortal or Treasure Immortal Lord had this tendency.

Nevertheless, destruction didn’t have the same impact as devouring. When worlds were destroyed, they would return in a different form in due time. Even if it took a million years, it was still a short period for immortals, since their lifespans were measured in billions.

As long as Heavenrealm wasn’t thoroughly destroyed or devoured, all other matters were insignificant.
